source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative file path LF, sorted; source-validation-001.json excluded

source_contract.context: Logical single-owner graph ticket; detached roots0/1 and ASID0 encode no live hardware context
source_contract.permissions: Only zero; all leaf/data mappings refused
source_contract.plan: Complete parent-first topology; level1 root entries0..1; level2 parent entries0..7; level3 parent entries0..2047; no duplicate parent/entry, cycle or forward reference
source_contract.write_path: Separate checked mutable bridge bound to the unchanged real IOBMD provider by uatb_iokit_init; exclusive private CPU writes only
source_contract.validation: Full expected page image match followed by unchanged frozen snapshot/graph validator
source_contract.lifecycle: One build attempt, no in-place edits. Private failure rolls back once and remains failed. Uncertain write/view/exposure quarantines all owned allocations; uncertain complete retains that allocation without retry; other private pages may release. No GPU/unload safety claim.

test_coverage: Both detached roots, full16-page graph and repeated successful read-only validation.
Invalid permissions/levels/root/parent entries, cycles, acyclic forward links, repeated parent entries,16/17-page boundary and no allocations on invalid plans.
Exact full-page zeroing and requested topology match, including a different but codec-valid graph refusal.
Allocation/prepare/partial-write faults at each ofthree allocation positions; late mutation before frozen graph validation; complete failures; uncertain writes and explicit quarantine.
Foreign/stale allocator and graph tokens, copied context, reentry, stale PA/VA/length/capacity/page-size/segment view, replayed build and repeated cleanup.
Zero/unaligned/too-high/duplicate physical pages and last valid36-bit page; mutable bridge byte-span boundaries, overflow, zero length and source alias.
development_observations: First16-mutant run refused to compile one mutation because removing the exact-image comparison left a parameter unused. Mutation was changed to retain that unused-reference statement; the final16 mutants all compiled and failed explicit runtime checks. No compile failure counted as detection.
Added direct checks for the common mutable-span helper so host boundary tests exercise the same span admission used by the actual IOBMD writer.
limits: No data leaves; empty L3 topology is not a working GPU address space.
No hardware publication, inherited firmware memory, cache/TLBI, firmware/RTKit endpoint activation, kext, service, node, boot package or target execution.
Caller owns serialized stable memory and trusted non-reentrant providers; the busy flag is not a concurrency lock and memory comparisons do not establish a concurrent race protocol.
CPU faults during actual kernel copying are not caught/rolled back. The tested partial-write error is a provider-reported failure guaranteed to remain private.
SDK object/import matches are compile/source evidence only; IOBMD virtual calls still lack new runtime ABI evidence.
The V13_5/G13 boot-metadata inference does not prove loaded firmware ABI or remove ownership/coherency/quiescence blockers.
scope_written: Only integrations/puredarwin/m1-gpu-uat-builder and reports/sprint-010/gpu-uat-builder-001.json; temporary compiler artifacts discarded.
